topics.topic: Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell investigation
topics.description: The Department of Justice dropped its criminal investigation into Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell, referring the matter to the Inspector General. This decision comes amid scrutiny of Powell's actions and potential conflicts of interest.
topics.reason: High-profile investigation into Federal Reserve Chair

topics.description: A Minnesota suicide prevention nonprofit lost $220K to theft by its executive director and relative. This incident raises concerns about the oversight and management of nonprofit organizations in Minnesota.
